note: Body has two lines, ' ))' and ' x', both starting with one space: the first trims to exactly '))' (forcing the stripped-form fallback), and every non-blank segment shares that one leading space at the same position. On re-parse, Sec 5.6's common-leading-whitespace computation cannot distinguish that shared leading space from writer-added structural indentation, and would strip it. See Sec 5.9.7. The String is wrapped in an Object (key 's') so it is not the bare document root: a bare String would fail ScalarRoot first, and the fixture must exercise exactly its named reason code (Sec 5.9.0).
